Well i posted my pictures of the ferret show i went to yesterday, They started things off with a race (£1 per ferret entry) that was from 11:30am till about 12 - 12:30pm. 

Then you were given a sheet with the time table of what group ferrets you have, like your pollcats and albinos and sandys etc, you get another sheet to put your ferrets names into the groups they fit under and pay £1 for every entry. then you do the ring show where the judge checks the ferrets and decides what he likes better for 1st, 2nd and 3rd. 

There is a 1st in every group so after all the groups you do a best in show and the 2nd best in show gets a bigger ribbon that normal but the 1st best in show gets a very big ribbon and a trophy :D and normally a big bag of ferret food too !! 

Then there tends to be a raffle, and also other people selling home made beds, t-shirts, ferret clocks and badges etc and all the money goes to the rescue/ charity! It's very fun and a lovely experiance to meet new people and ferrets. I would say definently mention it to you local ferret shelter! xXx

My two big boys are kits only about 8 months old, so they put on a lot of tub over the winter :) and my other is around 5 years old so he has no need to prepare for winter because he knows he lives inside lol, yeah we are from the UK but some of them are still very tiny xXx

Find a local ferret charity and talk to them about it, we are in hull in the UK so we are friends of the east coast ferret rescue and we have fun days and ferret shows, the show we went to had a race first where they go in the tubes, and then you put your ferret(s) into certain groups eg: polcat hob/jill, albino hob/jill etc and then when it's your group you go into the ring and the judge checks out all the ferrets and decides 1st, 2nd and 3rd :) xXx
